relation_statement: The embedding initialization std must compensate for the input embed_scale multiplier so the scaled embedding magnitude stays at the intended scale under guard that embed_scale is configured.
observable_signal: norm/std of the scaled embedding output at the transformer input (orders of magnitude above intended scale)
validity_precondition: fan_in init method selected together with a nontrivial embed_scale (e.g., sqrt(d_model))
evidence_from_issue: fan_in init for embeddings ignores embed_scale — embeddings remain std=1.0 and become huge after scaling
evidence_from_fix: init always used std=1.0; the transformer then multiplied embeddings by embed_scale, producing embeddings several orders of magnitude larger than intended

relation_statement: A captured parameter-cast graph for one virtual pipeline stage must write only its own stage's parameter buffer, leaving other stages' buffers unchanged.
observable_signal: parameter-buffer checksum of other virtual-pipeline stages before vs after cast-graph replay
validity_precondition: DDP enable_cuda_graph with multiple VPP stages on the same device sharing a single mempool
evidence_from_issue: DDP cast cudagraph manager runs warmup steps and shares mempool across virtual pipeline stages, corrupting captured param-cast outputs across VPP
evidence_from_fix: multiple VPP stages shared mempool and warmup buffers, so the captured cast graph for one VPP stage could write into another stage's parameter buffer

relation_statement: The quantization scale/amax state used by the recomputed forward must be consistent with the original forward pass under FP4 training with activation recompute enabled.
observable_signal: Amax-history length/content and per-module scale compared between the original forward and the recomputed forward; a recompute pass that does not extend amax history witnesses the violation.
validity_precondition: MoE layer with moe_layer_recompute enabled, config.fp4 set and config.fp8 unset
evidence_from_issue: FP4 recompute uses tensor_parallel.checkpoint and loses FP4 amax tracking
evidence_from_fix: te_checkpoint selected only when self.config.fp8 ... amax history is not extended for the recomputed forward, yielding mismatched scales between forward and recompute

relation_statement: MoE-shaped gradients must be correctly all-reduced (per-bucket, with comm_dtype downcast) and consistent across DP ranks, never zeroed, under guard: EP+DP MoE with MultiGroup DDP.
observable_signal: Per-parameter gradient values after reduction (nonzero, equal across DP ranks) and NCCL volume.
validity_precondition: MoE training with MultiGroupDistributedDataParallel, MoE-shaped params needing bucketed reduction
evidence_from_issue: MultiGroupDistributedDataParallel ... never wires per-bucket grad reduce
evidence_from_fix: MoE params reduced one-by-one, missing view-based bucket batching; skipped comm_dtype downcast and occasionally zeroed partial buckets

relation_statement: The optimizer's per-param step counter must equal the number of real parameter updates performed, so it must still be zero immediately after engine construction.
observable_signal: Adam state['step'] value after initialization vs number of completed optimizer updates (expected 0)
validity_precondition: optimizer wrapped by sharded/low-precision engine that materializes state at construction
evidence_from_issue: optimizer.step() called once during initialization, increments Adam step counter before any real update
evidence_from_fix: eager step() during construction silently incremented state['step'] for every param, so bias-correction terms were off by one

relation_statement: The fused cross-entropy path's effective z-loss multiplier must equal the configured value (nonzero when enabled) under guard: fused_loss and z-loss enabled.
observable_signal: Whether the z-loss term actually affects gradients/lse magnitude vs the logged nonzero z_loss value.
validity_precondition: softmax_auxiliary_loss=True and fused_loss=True (FlashAttention CrossEntropyLoss path)
evidence_from_issue: Fused cross_entropy path passes lse_square_scale=0 so z-loss term is silently dropped
evidence_from_fix: lse_square_scale hard-coded 0.0 disables the fused z-loss even though surrounding code adds a logged z_loss

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation buffer must be zero at the start of accumulation so the accumulated gradient equals the sum of microbatch gradients only.
observable_signal: nonzero main_grad buffer content (leftover main parameter values) before the first backward accumulation
validity_precondition: first training iteration after init/checkpoint with reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag and overlap_param_gather, before the forward_pre_hook is registered
evidence_from_issue: MXFP8 reuse_grad_buf pollutes main grads on first iter when forward_pre_hook is disabled
evidence_from_fix: copying main params into the shared param/grad buffer left main param values inside main_grad, silently turning the next gradient accumulation into 'main_grad += new_grad' with non-zero start state

relation_statement: Instances served from a cached index must conform to the currently configured sequence layout (sequence_length, bos handling) under guard that a disk cache from a prior run exists.
observable_signal: actual instance layout (sequence length / token boundaries) of served batches differing from the configured sequence_length
validity_precondition: fixed-sequence-length dataset variants with on-disk cached offsets; a later run changed layout-determining settings not included in the fingerprint
evidence_from_issue: fingerprint missed sequence_length / bos_token_id — wrong cache reused
evidence_from_fix: cached instance offsets computed under previous settings were reused when those settings changed, so returned instances no longer matched the configured sequence_length

relation_statement: All model parameters, including frozen (requires_grad=False) ones, must be bitwise restored after a checkpoint save/load round trip under sharded-optimizer training.
observable_signal: checksum of frozen parameters before save vs after load; presence of frozen parameter keys in the saved state
validity_precondition: model contains parameters with requires_grad=False; sharded parameter/optimizer state (ZeRO stage 3) enabled
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 checkpoint silently omits frozen (requires_grad=False) parameters from saved state
evidence_from_fix: checkpoint logic only iterated trainable parameters; frozen parameters were never written, so resume trains from random-initialised frozen weights

relation_statement: Any cached reference marking a gradient for reduction must be cleared or refreshed each iteration so that only current-iteration gradients enter the reduction, under non-contiguous gradient mode.
observable_signal: reduction consuming a gradient tensor produced in a previous iteration (stale pointer surviving across backward passes); divergence of reduced grads vs a fresh-recompute baseline
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 2 with contiguous_gradients=False and at least one param larger than reduce_bucket_size
evidence_from_issue: extra_large_param leaks reference when contiguous_gradients=False — silent stale-grad reduction in next step
evidence_from_fix: the assignment was a dead store but the reference outlived the iteration; the next backward saw the stale reference and reduced a previous-iteration gradient

relation_statement: The logged aux-loss metric must be invariant to activation checkpointing (counted once per step) under guard: act-checkpoint wraps the MoE block.
observable_signal: Logged per-step aux-loss metric vs true value (2x when forward reruns).
validity_precondition: MoEFusedV2TransformerBlock with routed_experts_router, activation checkpointing enabled
evidence_from_issue: MoE load-balancing aux loss accumulated to metrics twice when activation checkpointing recomputes the block
evidence_from_fix: compute_aux_loss accumulated on every forward; act-ckpt reruns forward in backward, adding it twice

relation_statement: The attention softmax scale must equal the YaRN mscale formula evaluated with mscale_all_dim under multi-latent attention when the two config fields differ.
observable_signal: computed softmax_scale value vs the config-derived expected value (off by an mscale_all_dim/mscale ratio)
validity_precondition: multi-latent attention with YaRN rotary_scaling_factor != 1.0 and mscale != mscale_all_dim
evidence_from_issue: MLA softmax_scale built from wrong mscale config field
evidence_from_fix: computed softmax_scale from self.config.mscale instead of self.config.mscale_all_dim, producing attention softmax scaling wrong by an mscale_all_dim/mscale ratio, silently distorting attention probabilities

relation_statement: The fp32-to-16-bit writeback after the offloaded optimizer step must target each param group's own rank partition, so every 16-bit partition equals its fp32 master partition.
observable_signal: per-group elementwise difference between bit16 partitions and their fp32 master partitions after step
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 2 with DeepSpeedCPUAdam offload and multiple param groups using different real_dp_process_group
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO2 + CPU offload: DeepSpeedCPUAdam fp32→fp16 partition_id is wrong across param groups
evidence_from_fix: the code used a single outer-scope partition_id for all groups instead of computing the rank within each group's real_dp_process_group; every group except the first received the wrong rank's partition

relation_statement: The bucket-local parameter index map must equal the globally padded parameter index map so optimizer read/write slices align with where the gradients live.
observable_signal: offset mismatch between the bucket-local param_to_index and the global param_index_map for params whose numel is not a multiple of dp_world_size
validity_precondition: DistributedOptimizer with per-param padding/alignment and buckets containing multiple params, at least one with numel not a multiple of data_parallel_world_size
evidence_from_issue: _ParamAndGradBucket builds local param_to_index from naive concatenation, ignoring per-param padding so optimizer reads from misaligned offsets
evidence_from_fix: param_to_index walked params with offset += param.numel() while the global param_index_map already had padded offsets; the optimizer wrote/read different slices than where the gradients lived

relation_statement: Zeroing a gradient buffer must leave parameter data of buckets still pending all-gather unchanged when grad and param buffers share storage.
observable_signal: parameter-buffer checksum of pending buckets before vs after grad_data zeroing
validity_precondition: reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag with overlap_param_gather and multiple buckets sharing grad/param storage
evidence_from_issue: mxfp8 reuse_grad_buf zeros wrong buffer (grad_data instead of param_data)
evidence_from_fix: zeroing bucket.grad_data also wiped out param data of other buckets that had not yet completed all-gather, silently corrupting weights

relation_statement: The reduce-scatter input buffer must be cast to the configured communication_data_type exactly when it differs from the model dtype under ZeRO-3.
observable_signal: dtype of the reduce-scatter buffer at collective launch compared against the configured communication_data_type
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with communication_data_type different from the model dtype
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 communication_data_type comparison inverted — buffer cast happens only when no cast is needed
evidence_from_fix: gate was `if self.communication_data_type == self.dtype:` — exactly backward; when the user requested a different communication dtype the buffer was NOT cast, so reduce-scatter ran on the wrong dtype

relation_statement: Per-rank recorded padding must sum to the total alignment padding of the flattened group, so that padding-trimmed optimizer state covers exactly the true parameter elements on every rank.
observable_signal: sum of recorded per-rank padding vs (aligned size - group numel); trimmed optimizer-state length vs true parameter element count on padding-bearing ranks
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 1/2 with DP world size large enough that alignment padding spans more than the last rank
evidence_from_issue: records padding only on last rank — middle ranks at large DP report padding=0 and contaminate optimizer state
evidence_from_fix: padding recorded only on partition_id == world_size-1; other padding ranks keep junk values treated as legitimate optimizer state on save

relation_statement: The RMSNorm weight multiply must be performed in the input dtype (bf16, cast back before multiply) to match trained Qwen3 semantics under guard: Qwen3 factory with bf16 inputs.
observable_signal: Numeric divergence of RMSNorm output from HF Qwen3RMSNorm reference on outlier channels.
validity_precondition: qwen3 model factory used with mixed-precision bf16 inputs
evidence_from_issue: RMSNorm casts back to og_dtype after weight multiply, diverging from HF Qwen3
evidence_from_fix: olmo-core did normalize->multiply->cast (multiply in fp32); HF casts before multiply so it is in bf16

relation_statement: The reported aux_loss must carry the correct normalization (not be scaled by the TP world size, and be reduced over the intended group) under TP>1.
observable_signal: Logged aux_loss magnitude vs the true per-token auxiliary loss: an offset by exactly the TP world-size factor witnesses the wrong scaling.
validity_precondition: MoE aux_loss metric logging with tensor parallelism enabled
evidence_from_issue: aux_loss metric incorrectly scaled by TP world_size, missing reduce_group
evidence_from_fix: (no root_cause text provided; inferred from title: scaling by TP world size applied without the corresponding reduce_group)

relation_statement: The auxiliary (indexer) loss scale must include the 1/num_microbatches divisor so its gradient contribution is weighted consistently with the main loss.
observable_signal: auxiliary-loss gradient contribution ratio vs the main loss (num_microbatches times larger)
validity_precondition: DSA attention variant with num_microbatches > 1 (gradient accumulation) and calculate_per_token_loss=False
evidence_from_issue: DSA indexer loss is not divided by num_microbatches, so the auxiliary loss gradient is overweighted by a factor of num_microbatches
evidence_from_fix: DSAIndexerLossAutoScaler was never given a per-microbatch divisor; the indexer auxiliary loss accumulates num_microbatches times into the gradient instead of being averaged

relation_statement: The token embedding table row count must equal the output projection's class count under guard: weight_tying=False.
observable_signal: Shape mismatch between wte.num_embeddings and ff_out.out_features; logits for ids in [vocab_size, embedding_size).
validity_precondition: embedding_size set distinct from vocab_size, weight_tying=False
evidence_from_issue: Token embedding sized by vocab_size instead of embedding_size, mismatching ff_out width
evidence_from_fix: wte used vocab_size but ff_out sized for embedding_size, so extra logits bias the softmax denominator with no learnable embedding

relation_statement: Gradients from multiple backward() calls within one optimizer step must all be preserved in the accumulation buffer under ZeRO-1/2 with CPU offload.
observable_signal: accumulated gradient norm at step time vs the sum of per-backward gradient contributions
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 1/2 with CPU offload and more than one backward() call per optimizer step
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
evidence_from_fix: root_cause field empty in record; inferred from title

relation_statement: The recorded gradient-norm metric must equal the true global gradient norm without an extra cross-rank reduction under guard TP is enabled and grad clipping is active.
observable_signal: recorded grad_norm metric compared against a recomputed global norm of the full gradients
validity_precondition: grad clipper callback active with max_grad_norm set; clip_grad_norm_ returns a distributed tensor
evidence_from_issue: Grad clipper recorded grad_norm DTensor — record_metric saw distributed value
evidence_from_fix: the raw DTensor grad_norm was not unwrapped; the metric system operated on it across ranks, producing a wrongly reduced grad-norm value

relation_statement: After a weights-only restore (restore_dataloader=False), the training step counter must be reset to 0 consistently with the other run counters so the LR schedule starts from warmup.
observable_signal: global_step and the LR value at the first resumed step: step equal to the checkpoint's step (e.g. 50000) with warmup skipped witnesses the missing reset.
validity_precondition: Resume from checkpoint with cfg.restore_dataloader=False (fresh run from saved weights)
evidence_from_issue: global_step not reset when restore_dataloader=False, so resumed runs keep the checkpoint's step counter
evidence_from_fix: restore_checkpoint() resets epoch and token counters but forgot to reset global_step; the LR scheduler starts at the checkpoint's step, silently skipping warmup and using a much smaller LR

relation_statement: The reduction buffer for an extra-large parameter must use the configured communication dtype (not param.dtype) so its gradient participates correctly in reduction.
observable_signal: missing or zero parameter update for the extra-large parameter despite nonzero local gradient; dtype of its reduction buffer vs comm_dtype
validity_precondition: parameter with numel exceeding the reduce bucket size and communication dtype differing from param dtype
evidence_from_issue: extra_large_param uses param.dtype instead of comm_dtype — gradient silently dropped
evidence_from_fix: root_cause field empty in record; inferred from title
